claim_scope.primary_claim: EAGC is noninferior to frozen Newell for post-cutoff minimum SYM-H on one strictly prospective 20-event ICME cohort
forbidden_inferences: No ICME result may be transferred to SIR.
Secondary descriptive baselines cannot alter the primary decision.
PASS-SUPERIOR cannot be reported unless every superiority condition passes on the prospective cohort.

freeze.resolution_rule: Use the earliest repository commit containing this exact protocol_id and protocol_version at this path. Current protocol bytes MUST equal the bytes at that commit.
freeze.time_field: Git committer timestamp of the introducing commit
freeze.prospective_boundary: Both icme_start_time and every catalog snapshot retrieval time MUST be strictly later than the resolved freeze timestamp.
freeze.amendment_policy: Any change to protocol bytes, cohort rules, model artifacts, endpoint, comparison, quality rules, or decisions requires a new protocol version and a new prospective freeze.

transitions: FROZEN-PRE-TARGET -> OPEN-ACCRUAL after protocol anchor verification
OPEN-ACCRUAL -> MANIFEST-CANDIDATE after exactly 20 append-only selections
MANIFEST-CANDIDATE -> TARGET-AUTHORIZATION-CANDIDATE only after the exact manifest is committed
TARGET-AUTHORIZATION-CANDIDATE -> TARGET-AUTHORIZED only after the exact authorization is committed in a later descendant commit
TARGET-AUTHORIZED -> SCORED after provenance-complete OMNI retrieval and quality evaluation
SCORED -> PASS-SUPERIOR | PASS-NONINFERIOR | REJECT by the exact decision rules
state_machine.rollback: No accrued event, manifest, authorization, target record, or score may be rewritten. Correction requires HOLD and a new protocol version.

eligibility.overlap_policy: Retain the earlier eligible row under cohort.ordering and permanently record the later row as SKIP-OVERLAP.

cohort.accrual_policy: Process every officially linked ICMECAT version >=2.3 in ascending semantic version. Record each first-seen post-freeze Wind row once. Append selections only; never recompute prior decisions.
cohort.catalog_revision_policy: Any change to a previously decided catalog row yields HOLD-CATALOG-REVISION; it cannot update or replace the row.
cohort.manifest_freeze_rule: The exact complete manifest must exist in an earlier commit before target authorization can be generated.

selector.name: HELIO4CAST ICMECAT
selector.discovery_policy: The accrual runner parses the official landing page, derives exact versioned URLs, rechecks hashes of processed versions, and processes unprocessed versions in ascending order.

predictors_and_target.name: NASA OMNI high-resolution 1-minute data
predictors_and_target.access_boundary: No OMNI request for a selected event window may occur until the exact manifest and exact authorization files are present in two ordered commits and all protocol/model hashes pass.

model.target_leakage_policy: Prospective targets cannot affect fitting, features, coefficients, scaling, calibration, or baselines.

comparison.primary_metric: RMSE over the 20 event-level observed and predicted minimum SYM-H values
comparison.bootstrap_encoding: uint8 row-major; 10000 rows of 20 zero-based indices
comparison.numeric_policy: Use unrounded Python float computations; round only for display.

PASS-NONINFERIOR: Point relative improvement is strictly greater than -0.05.
The frozen-index bootstrap fraction with relative improvement strictly greater than -0.05 is at least 0.90.
Every leave-one-event-out relative improvement is strictly greater than -0.05.
PASS-SUPERIOR: Point relative improvement is at least 0.05.
The frozen-index bootstrap fraction with relative improvement strictly greater than 0 is at least 0.90.
Every leave-one-event-out relative improvement is strictly greater than 0.
decision.REJECT: All 20 frozen events are SCORABLE and at least one PASS-NONINFERIOR condition fails.
decision.HOLD: Any incomplete cohort, non-SCORABLE event, zero Newell RMSE, missing provenance, hash mismatch, chronology failure, catalog revision, unauthorized target access, or other invariant violation.

data_quality.failure_policy: Fail closed to HOLD; never replace an accrued event.

required_artifacts: append-only target-blind manifest with snapshot receipts
frozen fitted model and training source hashes
per-event target source hashes, quality, predictions, and observed endpoint
machine-readable adjudication with protocol, manifest, authorization, model, scorer, and source identities
